font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
